title: The Cover Period a Repeat-Funded Micro Market Lot is Sized For
content:
Where an Unattended Micro Market Program agreement has already carried more than one subsidy funding lot, the cover the next lot is sized for is taken from the drawable life the market format keeps a lot for rather than from the standard cover.

## The clause

1. Where the market format keeps a funding lot drawable for at or beyond 12 months, and the agreement carries at or above 2 funding lots, the cover runs to the whole of the drawable life.
2. Where the market format keeps a funding lot drawable for below 12 months, and the agreement carries at or above 2 funding lots, the cover runs to half the drawable life, rounded up to a whole month.
3. Where the agreement carries fewer than 2 funding lots, no such change to the cover period is made.

## The boundaries

The long drawable life is 12 months: a format keeping a lot drawable for exactly 12 months is at or beyond it, and a format keeping one drawable for 9 months is below it. The repeat funding count is 2 subsidy funding lots on the agreement, counted over the whole life of the agreement: exactly 2 meets it, 1 does not.

| Months the format keeps a lot drawable | Funding lots on the agreement | Cover period |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 12 or more | 2 or more | the whole of the drawable life |
| fewer than 12 | 2 or more | half the drawable life, rounded up to a whole month |
| any | 1 or none | no such change is made |

*Hypothetical.* An agreement carrying 3 funding lots on a format keeping a lot drawable for 12 months is sized for 12 months of cover. The same agreement on a format keeping a lot drawable for 9 months is sized for 5 months of cover, half of 9 rounded up to a whole month. On a format keeping a lot drawable for 6 months it is sized for 3 months.
